support_claim: Commercial notes state that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and instruct that the registry link be treated as unresolved, while the registry row names NORTHBRIDGE ANALYTICS LLC and billing records use Northbridge Analytics Inc. without an identity link between them.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and DISTINCT requires establishing evidence of distinctness; name similarity and compatible naming are insufficient, and absence of identity proof does not license DISTINCT. The packet preserves multiple live candidates (Inc. billing name versus Wyoming LLC registry entries) and explicitly marks the registry link unresolved, so neither positive nor negative disposition burden is met.
